主要内容: On February 16, 2012, SAP AG and SuccessFactors, Inc. issued a joint press release announcing the successful completion of a cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of common stock of SuccessFactors by Saturn Expansion Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of SAP America, Inc. The tender offer expired on February 15, 2012. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The document also includes forward-looking statements regarding future financial results, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. These statements are based on SAP's and SuccessFactors' filings with the SEC, including their Form 20-F and Form 10-Q reports. The provided text is a Form 6-K filing by SAP AG, dated February 17, 2012. This filing is a regulatory document under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, signed by authorized signatories, Michael Ploetner and Wendy Boufford. The filing includes an exhibit, Exhibit No. 99.1, which is a joint press release issued by SAP and SuccessFactors on February 16, 2012. The document indicates that SAP AG has officially submitted this report as required by the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is relevant to the company's regulatory compliance and communication with investors.
